comment: pairs, not single artifacts. `stored` is the checkpoint this reader already holds, over the entries in `../served`; `serve` is the log it is then offered, tiles and all, as a real log would serve it. §10's stored-checkpoint block and §11's duties are reached by nothing else here. fork-on-a-shorter-branch is the one that matters most: it is what a forking log looks like when it hides behind "logs do not shrink"
